notes: ch12 do-file: gllamm brand ... feature pricec, i(house) link(mlogit) (random-intercept multinomial/discrete choice over 4 brands). formula: Height (cm) ~ poly(Age centered about 13 years, 4) + cos(Season) + sin(Season) + (1 + Age + I(Age^2) | ID)
notes: Goldstein (2003) Oxford Boys growth data: height on centred age with a random slope per boy (ID); the classic polynomial-growth example (same data as nlme Oxboys and cmm_oxboys). SPOT CHECK (Alex, 2026-10-08): the documented growth model is a fourth-degree polynomial in centred age with correlated random intercept, age and age-squared effects by boy, season as sinusoidal terms in the extended model; polynomial terms are not representable beyond the column, as muscatine in #22.

formula: logfev1 ~ age + log(ht) + baseage + log(baseht) + (1 + age | id)
notes: Read help page (Six Cities Study, Topeka girls; Dockery et al. 1983). Long form, 300 girls, 1-12 visits; id = girl. logfev1 is log(FEV1), the raw FEV1 not in the table.
